contracts.status: User-confirmed two sequential race components with normal events and shared nested history.
contracts.eligibleFamilyPolicy: Use the complete canonical main race pool, including Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris, Anime MC and Heavenly Principle. Filter all previously selected families; Hybrid is already used when its event starts, so it cannot select itself.
contracts.componentResolution: Spin component 1, commit its family/history before dispatch, and finish every immediate event and nested race chain. Register later-stage tickets without advancing main stages. Only then spin component 2 using the accumulated history and run its events the same way.
contracts.distinctnessPolicy: Before every identity-family draw disable ALL previously committed families across both roots and every nested host/origin, not just the first root or final leaf. Filter before draw, never reroll forbidden results.
contracts.poolExhaustion: A required draw with no eligible positive-weight candidate is an explicit configuration error. Never reset history, restore used sections, silently skip, or reroll a committed result.
contracts.eventOrder: Hybrid result/reaction → component 1 result/reaction and complete immediate nested chain → component 2 result/reaction and complete immediate chain → record completion → saved caller. No fusion stability or dominance wheel.
contracts.eventScope: Only an actual explicit Hybrid family selection opens this two-root sequence; lore Half-Ghoul/Half-Demon/Demigod or reference ancestry does not dispatch it automatically.
contracts.journalPolicy: Two stable root slots 1/2, with separately linked host/origin descendants. Every invocation carries component/parent/root-slot and return continuation. History is shared globally.
contracts.effectsPolicy: Retain every explicitly approved grant, modifier, guarantee and deferred ticket from both actual chains. Apply each source once under source-once additive stacking with no numeric floor/cap. No blanket stat addition, halving, automatic power package, suppression or extra mastery spin.
contracts.anatomyPolicy: Store both root identities and nested modifiers in one body brief. Anatomical conflict/body-reference policy remains pending; do not invent stability/dominance results or discard committed race rewards.
contracts.returnTo: saved caller; initial main Race completion enters Archetype gate, while a Hybrid selected inside Mutant returns to the saved mutation event after both roots/events complete
contracts.size: One global Size spin. Any committed Raksasa component binds existing giant variant; otherwise use explicit sourced body/reference composition rules. Do not average unknown measurements.
contracts.mastery: All owned powers share the existing single character mastery and scoped Authority exception. Weapons keep their normal per-weapon mastery/Enchant.
contracts.context: Append actual roots, nested families, grants, modifiers and upcoming steps with provenance. Future second race and final stats remain unknown until committed.
contracts.idempotence: Keys include root slot and nested component/step. Resume restores a committed result and continues its unfinished children, never applies history to reroll it or executes an event twice.
contracts.budgets: Validate configured event budgets can support required chains. Current numerical limits are proposed; on required overflow fail configuration, never truncate the two-root sequence.

hybridContract.eligibleFamilyPolicy: Choose supported base-identity families, including Anime MC and Heavenly Principle. Exclude Hybrid itself and the Reinkarnasi Pahlawan Legendaris legacy family.
hybridContract.componentResolution: Resolve each selected family identity selector before the next component. A resolved Anime MC template or divine subtype keeps its identity metadata; it does not restart main race selection.
hybridContract.distinctnessPolicy: Second-family candidates exclude the first selected family in the starter recipe. Pre-filter their descendant outcomes to retain a distinct normalized resolved race signature; never reroll a committed result.
hybridContract.poolExhaustion: A required empty family/subtype pool is a configuration error. Do not silently skip a component or reroll.
hybridContract.eventOrder: After both identities resolve, merge traits once, resolve fusion stability and dominance, then compatible component events once per stable component slot.
hybridContract.eventScope: The hybrid fusion event belongs only to an explicit Hybrid selection. Existing Half-Ghoul, Half-Demon, Demigod, or mixed wayang ancestry does not auto-dispatch it.
hybridContract.journalPolicy: Record each parent selector with its own stable component slot and full family/subtype provenance. Repeated selector IDs do not share one consumed-event key.
hybridContract.effectsPolicy: Use bounded/normalized component profiles with deduplicated traits and explicit anatomy/ability conflicts. Hybrid does not automatically add every stat, grant every source power, or bypass weapon/power mastery.
hybridContract.anatomyPolicy: Produce one coherent final body brief from both resolved identities, their body forms, and dominance outcome.

bodyCompositionContract.basis: Only actually committed owned races, subtypes and grants; either body may contribute anatomy/visual traits. No first-race dominance rule.
bodyCompositionContract.wrappers: Symbiote follows actual host; Raksasa retains its giant binding and enlarges actual base body. Preserve Skeleton/Zombie origin and undead identity.
bodyCompositionContract.commit: Generate and validate one coherent body blueprint per actual composition revision. Freeze source IDs, normal form/anatomy, visible features, capabilities and body metric; replay/rendering reuse it. Do not repeatedly regenerate to obtain a better Archetype pool.
bodyCompositionContract.mechanicalBoundary: Visual mixing grants no extra power, stat, mastery, race, weapon, Size result or new selector. Body-role requirements inspect validated anatomy and authorized source capabilities; AI cannot invent eligibility/reward or change the accepted strong-package skip.
bodyCompositionContract.mutantGate: Keep original pre-Mutant Archetype plan/selection. Update current body blueprint after actual acquired-race completion; do not rerun the main gate.
bodyCompositionContract.size: One global Size stage using a documented numerical reference for the committed body; giant binding retains its existing Size wheel. Reference selection details remain for Size design.
bodyCompositionContract.implementation: Body generator/validator and catalog capability adapters remain future implementation work, not a manual approval prompt for each character.
